title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along University Boulevard and downtown Steubenville corridors, each with one specific reason to stop.

cards.entity_name: Best Western Plus Franciscan Square Inn and Suites
cards.title: See Campus Scenes Inside the Inn
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor — campus-facing hotel
cards.notes: Cross University Boulevard and look for the lobby artwork depicting Franciscan landmarks, including the Portiuncula Chapel and steel cross.
cards.short_summary: A campus-facing hotel lobby incorporates recognizable Franciscan imagery.
cards.evidence_claim: The hotel is across University Boulevard from Franciscan’s main entrance, and its interior displays photographs and artwork of campus landmarks.
cards.source_title: The Inn at Franciscan Square Opens for Business
cards.access_notes: Hotel common areas serve guests and visitors; confirm any access restrictions with staff.

cards.title: Grab a Sandwich Across from Campus
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor — Franciscan Square
cards.notes: Walk across University Boulevard for a quick sandwich stop in Franciscan Square, the mixed-use development opposite the university.
cards.short_summary: This alumni-operated franchise anchors a convenient campus-adjacent food stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan Magazine reports that Jimmy John’s opened in Franciscan Square on University Boulevard, across the street from the university.
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant; check the location’s current hours before leaving campus.

cards.title: Choose from the Pizza Menu
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor — Franciscan Square
cards.notes: Use the University Boulevard crossing to reach Rubi’s, where the documented menu spans pizza, stromboli, wings, burgers, subs, and salads.
cards.short_summary: A broad casual menu makes this a flexible Franciscan Square meal stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan University identifies Rubi’s Pizza & Grill as a Franciscan Square restaurant offering pizza, stromboli, wings, burgers, subs, and more.
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant in Franciscan Square; verify current service hours directly.

cards.title: Step Into the Reconstructed Fort
cards.subtitle: South Third Street corridor — Fort Steuben Park
cards.notes: Head to South Third Street to examine reconstructed quarters, a guardhouse, hospital, herb garden, and archaeology site tied to the 1780s fort.
cards.short_summary: The riverfront reconstruction interprets military and surveying life in early Ohio.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service describes Historic Fort Steuben as a reconstructed military fort with an herb garden, archaeology site, and visitor center.
cards.access_notes: Fort amenities include interpretive exhibits, seating, picnic tables, restrooms, and parking; confirm tour availability.

cards.title: Browse Nutcrackers Year-Round
cards.subtitle: North Fourth Street corridor — downtown storefront
cards.notes: Follow North Fourth Street to browse the year-round display of nutcrackers alongside locally made ornaments, stationery, and children’s craft items.
cards.short_summary: A highly photographable downtown storefront carries Steubenville-made holiday pieces.
cards.evidence_claim: The business identifies Drosselmeyer’s as a year-round Christmas store at 155 North Fourth Street with nutcrackers and locally made holiday gifts.
cards.access_notes: Public retail shop; browsing is available during posted business hours.

cards.title: Browse the Theology and Classics Shelves
cards.subtitle: North Fourth Street corridor — downtown bookstore
cards.notes: Continue along North Fourth Street and browse BookMarx’s literature, theology, Catholic, classical-language, and local-interest collections.
cards.short_summary: The independent shop gives the Fourth Street walk a book-focused stop.
cards.evidence_claim: BookMarx describes itself as a Steubenville bookstore focused on influential books, with strengths in theology, Catholic books, Latin, and Greek.
cards.access_notes: Public bookstore; consult the shop directly for current opening hours and events.

cards.entity_name: Public Library of Steubenville and Jefferson County — Main Library
cards.title: Use the Downtown Main Library
cards.subtitle: South Fourth Street corridor — Carnegie library
cards.notes: Walk South Fourth Street to read, research, or ask about the makerspace and Library of Things in Steubenville’s named Main Library building.
cards.short_summary: The historic downtown library adds research and making resources to the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s official site lists the Main Library at 407 South Fourth Street and highlights its makerspace and Library of Things.
cards.source_title: Public Library of Steubenville and Jefferson County
cards.access_notes: Public library; check the official site for current hours, borrowing rules, and makerspace availability.

cards.title: Study the Greek-Style Architecture
cards.subtitle: South Fourth Street corridor — historic church
cards.notes: Pause at South and Fourth Streets to view the church’s classical exterior; contact the parish before planning an interior architectural visit.
cards.short_summary: A documented Greek congregation occupies a distinctly classical downtown landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The Steubenville Visitor Center places Holy Trinity at 300 South Fourth Street and documents its classical Greek architecture and local parish history.
cards.access_notes: View the exterior from public sidewalks; contact the parish before entering outside scheduled services or events.

cards.title: Explore Nineteen Rooms of Local History
cards.subtitle: Franklin Avenue corridor — historic mansion museum
cards.notes: Turn onto Franklin Avenue for exhibits inside a 19-room mansion; confirm the museum’s limited schedule before making the trip downtown.
cards.short_summary: A residential-scale museum presents artifacts, genealogy, and local personalities.
cards.evidence_claim: The historical society lists its museum at 426 Franklin Avenue; the visitor center describes a 19-room mansion with period artifacts and genealogy holdings.
cards.source_title: Contact Us — Jefferson County Ohio Historical Society
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Wednesday and Thursday, 10 a.m.–3 p.m.; verify before visiting because access is limited.

cards.title: Make North Street a Pasta Stop
cards.subtitle: North Street corridor — downtown restaurant
cards.notes: Walk the North Street block to a long-running downtown restaurant and use its official page to confirm service before planning a pasta meal.
cards.short_summary: A named North Street restaurant supplies a clear food-focused reason for the block.
cards.evidence_claim: Naples Spaghetti House’s official contact page places the restaurant at 329 North Street and publishes its current weekly service schedule.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Tuesday–Sunday service and Monday closure; recheck hours before departure.

warnings: The board interprets “blocks” as named, map-listed destinations on specific campus-adjacent or downtown corridors; downtown stops require travel beyond the immediate campus edge.
Coordinates are null because exact point coordinates were not independently verified from authoritative destination pages.
